source_title: News Omar Abdullah Marries Journalist Nidhi Razdan In New Delhi, Shares 'New Journey' Post
source_excerpt:
Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah has married journalist Nidhi Razdan in New Delhi.
“A new journey began yesterday..." Abdullah said in a post on X on Saturday (October 31, 2026).
According to sources, the marriage was solemnised under the Special Marriage Act in New Delhi on Friday (October 30, 2026). Family members from both sides were among the witnesses.

The marriage is the second for both. The 56-year-old Chief Minister's first marriage to Payal was dissolved by a Supreme Court order in July this year after the couple reached a settlement.
A new journey began yesterday 💍@Nidhi https://t.co/BXbdLq2d1H
Wedding functions were held in Srinagar and New Delhi and attended by family members and close relatives from both sides.
Omar Abdullah's parents, Farooq Abdullah and Mollie, his three sisters and other close relatives attended the functions. Nidhi Razdan's parents, veteran journalist M.K. Razdan and Sarla Razdan, were also present.
